n7292c1025f.headline: Bulgaria utilities regulator raises gas prices by 5.0% for May
n7292c1025f.summary: Bulgaria's utilities regulator approved a 5.0 per cent increase in the regulated gas price for May, setting it at 35.98 euros per MWh excluding transportation.
n7292c1025f.why: Regulated gas prices feed into household and industrial energy costs in Bulgaria.

n181fd603bd.headline: Iran threatens painful response if US resumes attacks
n181fd603bd.summary: Tehran warned Washington that it faces a lengthy conflict if it attacks again, following reports that the US has prepared further action. The warning raises the risk of renewed Middle East hostilities.
n181fd603bd.why: Iran is a major oil producer and any renewed US-Iran conflict can disrupt crude supply routes and push up energy prices.
n181fd603bd.why_moved: The threat of renewed US-Iran hostilities raises concern about disruption to Gulf oil flows, which can lift crude prices.

n1c6100cd65.headline: Spain's BBVA Posts Earnings Beat as Sustained Loan Growth Cushions Costs -- Update
n1c6100cd65.summary: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria reported higher profit on continued lending growth and steady performance in its largest markets. Those gains offset heavier costs, according to the update.
n1c6100cd65.why: BBVA is one of Spain's largest banks with major operations in Mexico, Turkey and South America, so its results signal lending and credit trends across several markets.

n195a8b7c53.headline: Azerbaijani oil price exceeds $122
n195a8b7c53.summary: Azerbaijan's Azeri Light crude rose in price on global markets, APA-Economics reported. The report puts the grade's price above $122 a barrel.
n195a8b7c53.why: Azeri Light is a benchmark Caspian crude grade, and its price tracks broader Mediterranean and global crude conditions.

n79d3e3d7ed.headline: Global commodity prices seen up 16% in 2026, stoking inflation
n79d3e3d7ed.summary: Global commodity prices are forecast to rise 16% in 2026, a surge that could add to inflation pressures across economies.
n79d3e3d7ed.why: Broad commodity price gains raise input costs for producers and consumers and feed into inflation and central bank policy.

nbff71b5d19.headline: Spanish growth defies Mideast war impact in first quarter - Latest News
nbff71b5d19.summary: Spain's economy grew 0.6% in the first quarter, in line with expectations, withstanding the turmoil from the Middle East war, official data showed.
nbff71b5d19.why: Spain is one of the euro area's larger economies, and its quarterly growth informs euro-area growth expectations and European bond markets.

n691833a1ab.headline: European Commission report praises smooth and efficient introduction of the euro in Bulgaria
n691833a1ab.summary: A European Commission report adopted on April 30 concluded that Bulgaria's introduction of the euro was smooth and efficient. Bulgaria joined the euro area on January 1, 2026.
n691833a1ab.why: Euro adoption changes Bulgaria's monetary framework, with the European Central Bank setting its interest rates and the lev being replaced by the euro.

nb58d06762a.headline: Woolies cites post-COVID instability in prices stoush
nb58d06762a.summary: Australia's biggest supermarket chain defended its discounts, citing post-COVID price instability. The consumer watchdog is pursuing a joint court case against the company.
nb58d06762a.why: Woolworths is one of Australia's largest grocery retailers, so regulatory action over pricing affects its earnings and reputation. Pricing practices are a key focus of Australian consumer regulators.

n10fccbeb50.headline: Adani Enterprises posts flat EBITDA, Q4 loss on depreciation hit; stock slips
n10fccbeb50.summary: Adani Enterprises reported flat EBITDA and a fourth-quarter loss due to depreciation. Full-year FY26 income rose 3%, and the stock slipped after the results.
n10fccbeb50.why: Adani Enterprises is the listed flagship of the Adani Group, with exposure to mining, ports, airports and energy in India. Its results are followed as a bellwether for the group.

impacts.name: Adani Enterprises
impacts.why: A fourth-quarter loss and the reported stock slip reflect weaker near-term results.

n3edfdbfbf3.headline: Eight banks now backing SoftBank’s record $40 billion OpenAI loan
n3edfdbfbf3.summary: Eight banks, including HSBC, BNP Paribas and Intesa Sanpaolo, are joining SoftBank's $40 billion bridge loan linked to OpenAI. The loan is described as a record.
n3edfdbfbf3.why: SoftBank Group is a Tokyo-based investment holding company with large stakes in technology firms, and its financing moves signal exposure to AI investments.

n5936f00800.headline: EBA calls on Verkhovna Rada to abolish preferential tax treatment for parcels worth up to EUR 150
n5936f00800.summary: The European Business Association called on Ukrainian lawmakers to adopt a bill abolishing the VAT exemption on international postal and express shipments worth up to EUR 150. The association is pressing for equal tax treatment of imports.
n5936f00800.why: VAT exemptions on low-value parcels affect the price competitiveness of domestic retailers versus cross-border e-commerce sellers.

nc78e6066be.headline: NBU increases its current account deficit forecast for 2026 by 6.7%
nc78e6066be.summary: In its April macroeconomic forecast, the National Bank of Ukraine raised its 2026 current account deficit estimate by $2.5 billion, or 6.7%, to $39.7 billion. The revision compares with the January forecast.
nc78e6066be.why: The current account balance shows how much a country relies on foreign financing, which affects its currency and external debt.

nc40f1f6f2f.headline: Metinvest appoints Kamet Steel and Zaporizhia Coke Plant as additional guarantors of issued Eurobonds
nc40f1f6f2f.summary: Metinvest B.V., the Netherlands-based parent of the Metinvest mining and metallurgical group, appointed Kamet Steel and Zaporizhia Coke and Chemical Plant as additional guarantors of its issued Eurobonds.
nc40f1f6f2f.why: Metinvest is one of Ukraine's largest steel and mining groups, and guarantees strengthen the credit support behind its international bonds.

n93db8c1993.headline: Sensex falls 582 pts, Nifty slips below 24,000 as oil woes, rupee weakness weigh on markets
n93db8c1993.summary: Indian benchmark indexes fell as crude prices rose and the rupee hit a record low. The Sensex dropped 582 points and the Nifty slipped below 24,000.
n93db8c1993.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark equity indexes of India's stock exchanges, so their moves reflect broad sentiment in Indian equities. Crude oil is a major import cost for India, so oil price rises pressure the rupee and corporate margins.
n93db8c1993.why_moved: Crude prices rose sharply while the rupee weakened to a record low, weighing on Indian equities. Higher oil costs and a weaker currency pressure earnings expectations for oil-importing economies.

n61119aec73.headline: NBU considers yield on govt bonds acceptable
n61119aec73.summary: National Bank of Ukraine deputy governor Volodymyr Lepushynsky said yields of 15-16% on domestic government bonds exceed current inflation and projected year-end inflation of 9.4%.
n61119aec73.why: Government bond yields reflect the cost of state borrowing and real returns relative to inflation. The National Bank of Ukraine oversees monetary policy and financial stability.

n510817d2dd.headline: Rupee's slide to a record low of 95.33 puts RBI back on the defensive
n510817d2dd.summary: The rupee slid to a record low of 95.33 against the US dollar, raising concerns for the Reserve Bank of India amid rising oil prices and economic challenges.
n510817d2dd.why: The rupee's level affects import costs, inflation and the central bank's policy options, and India is a large oil importer.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: The currency fell to a record low against the US dollar.

n510817d2dd.why_moved: The rupee dropped to 95.33 per dollar amid rising oil prices, adding pressure on the currency and the central bank.

na165a9b884.headline: Trump tightens naval blockade as Iranian rial collapses to record low
na165a9b884.summary: The Iranian rial has fallen to a record low as the US tightens its naval blockade. The report notes the rial previously dropped from about 1.4 million to 1.6 million per US dollar within a week.
na165a9b884.why: The rial's exchange rate reflects Iran's economic stress under sanctions and conflict, and shapes inflation and trade conditions for the country.

impacts.why: The rial has reached a record low against the US dollar, as reported.

n0875c79db7.headline: Amid global uncertainties, strong cargo volumes steer Adani Ports Q4 earnings
n0875c79db7.summary: Adani Ports reported a 10.5% rise in profit to ₹3,329 crore, driven by increased cargo volumes and strong revenue growth in the fourth quarter.
n0875c79db7.why: Adani Ports operates India's largest private port network, so cargo volumes there are a direct gauge of India's trade activity.

entities.name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone

n795a67eb8f.headline: Cognac boosts Rémy Cointreau in Q4
n795a67eb8f.summary: Rémy Cointreau's organic sales were flat at 0.2% growth in 2025-26, while its Cognac division grew 15.5% in the fourth quarter.
n795a67eb8f.why: Rémy Cointreau is a French spirits group whose Cognac business is a major driver of its earnings and is sensitive to Chinese and US demand.

n480a7ef1dc.headline: Treasurer downplays property tax windfall from budget
n480a7ef1dc.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers is playing down the amount of extra revenue that changes to negative gearing and capital gains tax will raise. The article gives no figures.
n480a7ef1dc.why: Negative gearing and capital gains tax rules affect property investment returns and federal budget revenue in Australia.

n31a54b7831.headline: SEBI approves change of control at RBL Bank in Emirates NBD stake deal
n31a54b7831.summary: India's markets regulator SEBI approved Emirates NBD's $3 billion acquisition of a 60% stake in RBL Bank. The approval marks a significant milestone for the deal.
n31a54b7831.why: RBL Bank is a private Indian lender, and a change of control in such a bank affects its ownership, governance and strategy.

n7a60a31450.headline: Samsung chip income soars nearly 50-fold for record quarterly profit
n7a60a31450.summary: Samsung Electronics reported a record quarterly profit, driven by a 49-fold jump in chip income. The company also warned of challenges ahead, according to the report.
n7a60a31450.why: Samsung is a major global maker of memory chips and smartphones, so its chip division results are closely watched across the semiconductor sector.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Samsung reported a record quarterly profit driven by its chip business.

n7a60a31450.why_moved: A record quarterly profit driven by a sharp rise in chip income is a strong earnings result for a large index heavyweight.

ncde30d666c.headline: Nearly 100,000 people in serious debt but arrears ease for many households
ncde30d666c.summary: Centrix data showed 459,000 people were behind on payments in March. Arrears eased for many households, although nearly 100,000 people remain in serious debt.
ncde30d666c.why: Household payment arrears signal consumer financial stress, which affects bank loan quality and consumer spending.

n7a38fd3cf6.headline: Nvidia B300 servers sell for $1 million in China, nearly double the US price
n7a38fd3cf6.summary: Nvidia B300 servers now sell for $1 million in China, nearly double US prices, after a Supermicro smuggling arrest closed the grey market. The price gap reflects restricted supply.
n7a38fd3cf6.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerators, and US export controls on its chips to China affect its revenue and the AI hardware supply chain.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Grey-market B300 prices in China show strong demand for Nvidia chips despite export restrictions.

n3d6afbd597.headline: Manufacturing outlook clouded by geopolitical risks - Taipei Times
n3d6afbd597.summary: Taiwan's manufacturing sector rebounded last month as domestic demand and AI-driven growth gathered pace, though geopolitical risks in the Middle East cast a shadow over the outlook.
n3d6afbd597.why: Taiwan is a leading global producer of advanced chips, so its manufacturing cycle reflects worldwide AI hardware demand.

n45b748031a.headline: Central bank concerned over inflation risks - Taipei Times
n45b748031a.summary: The central bank kept interest rates unchanged, and minutes of its last meeting show policymakers are increasingly alert to external shocks destabilising inflation expectations.
n45b748031a.why: The central bank sets Taiwan's policy rate, which influences the Taiwan dollar, local bond yields and borrowing costs.

ne3bb2a844f.headline: China policy sparks dilemma - Taipei Times
ne3bb2a844f.summary: New Chinese regulations aimed at stabilising industrial supply chains create a dilemma, as complying with US restrictions would breach Chinese law while ignoring them could bring US sanctions.
ne3bb2a844f.why: Conflicting US and Chinese rules can force multinationals to choose between legal regimes, affecting operations and investment.

n4057d4b9bf.headline: US-China trade officials hold ‘candid talks’ weeks ahead of Trump–Xi summit
n4057d4b9bf.summary: US and Chinese trade officials held open discussions on trade issues weeks before a possible meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, aimed at preparing for the summit and reducing tensions.
n4057d4b9bf.why: US-China trade relations affect global supply chains, tariffs and sentiment across equities, currencies and commodities.

n7a87768de6.headline: Taiwan’s Q1 GDP far better than expected at 13.69% - Taipei Times
n7a87768de6.summary: Taiwan's first-quarter GDP grew 13.69%, far better than expected, according to Taipei Times.
n7a87768de6.why: GDP growth is a core measure of economic health and shapes central bank policy, currency expectations and equity sentiment for Taiwan's export-heavy economy.

nd336e43ac6.headline: Minimum wage soon to pass NT$30,000: Lai - Taipei Times
nd336e43ac6.summary: President William Lai said Taiwan's minimum wage will soon pass NT$30,000, according to Taipei Times.
nd336e43ac6.why: Minimum wage increases raise labour costs for employers, particularly in retail, hospitality and manufacturing.
